title: Integer tick clock and host lock (O4): release plan for the owner's sign-off, no code
zone: specs/SPEC-0001 (o4-release-plan.md, README.md), handoffs/evidence/o4-* (measurement programs and outputs). Nothing under crates/
why_risk: clock and host-sync rewrite (AGENTS.md high tier): a late or doubled note is the failure the constitution calls a catastrophe (N5)
spec_rev: SPEC-0001 r2: the owner approved a release plan and a re-read of both specs for O4 and nothing else (2026-09-29, 15:11). The plan proposes r3 wording (section 8), not applied.
artifact: specs/SPEC-0001/o4-release-plan.md on branch conductor/o4-release-plan, based on metronome/command-ring
evidence: Constant tempo, 4 tempo/rate pairs, buffers 64 to 4,096: worst note-on error 1.02 samples (at most 21.8 us), sigma 0.29 samples (6.5 us), identical at every buffer size. The docs/03 section 7 jitter target is already met. handoffs/evidence/o4-baseline-ab-d.txt (A)
60 to 180 BPM ramp over 8 bars: last note 24.05 ms late at 32-sample buffers and 38.07 ms at 2,048 (1,154 to 1,827 samples). o4-baseline-ab-d.txt (B)
60 to 120 ramp then constant tempo: lateness 23.92 ms at the end of the ramp and still 23.92 ms 12 seconds later, so the offset never recovers. o4-baseline-c-s-f.txt (C)

Cause tested: reporting the tempo earlier by 0, 10, 20, 25, 30, 40 ms gives 25.6, 18.9, 12.3, 8.9, 5.6, -1.1 ms late. The engine fixes each tick's length from the tempo of the render call that stepped it, up to 12 ticks plus a chunk before it sounds. o4-baseline-c-s-f.txt (S), engine.rs render_core

f32 step accumulator vs exact tick over all 159 reduced multipliers up to 16: 49 fire a step 1 tick out within 30 minutes at 120 BPM, 80 within 7 hours (still at most 1 tick), 87 within 72 hours with worst error 9 ticks. Latent: nothing but a test can set a track speed multiplier. o4-baseline-c-s-f.txt (F)

Model of the proposed arithmetic (integer tick positions, converted to samples only when their buffer renders), every tick of the reference ramp: host position mode is exact on a steady ramp and within 0.33 samples at 512, 1.3 at 1,024, 5.2 at 2,048, 21.3 at 4,096 in the two buffers where the ramp starts; free-running worst 0.68, 2.7, 10.8, 42.8. o4-model.txt. This is a model, not engine code
An earlier draft of the model counted only every 12th tick and so missed the first-buffer error at 2,048; rerunning with every tick corrected it before it went into the plan
The mcc_and_transport golden changes tempo 100 to 140 mid-run, so 4b is expected to change that one golden; the other four are constant tempo
Manual pp.93 and 94 (the only pages on external clock) say nothing about song position or locate; D5 records both readings
unresolved: D1 to D6 in section 0 of the plan need the owner's answer. D1 (approve, change or reject) blocks everything. Owner: @beaudesign
D2 proposes dropping the PLL that tech.md F2 and docs/10 R4 ask for. Owner: @beaudesign; docs/10 R4 belongs to the Scribe
A loopback test in Live 12 is a release condition this session cannot meet (no host available). Owner: @beaudesign
The verify:timing gate is not_implemented and the guard tests G1 to G6 are its first content. Needs a Referee request when 4a opens
docs/02 section 5 lines 216 and 220 and docs/03 sections 5 and 7 need the Scribe (already partly requested in journal/metronome/requests/)
next: Owner decision on the plan. If approved: step 1 of section 10 (guard tests and the null host, committed alone), then PR 4a, 4b, 4c, each with its own review. If changes are asked for: revise the plan only. No code until then.

title: Independent review of the O4 release plan, revision 1, and what was done about it
zone: specs/SPEC-0001/o4-release-plan.md, tests/conformance/AMBIGUITIES.md, handoffs, journal. Nothing in crates/
why_risk: as the plan: clock and host-sync rewrite
spec_rev: SPEC-0001 r2 (owner approved a plan and a re-read of the specs, and nothing else)
evidence: The reviewer read revision 1 against the engine source and the manual and raised the findings listed in section 11 of the plan; every one was checked against the code before being accepted. Dispositions are in section 11 (where each went).

Checked by measurement after the review: at 110 BPM the running sum puts 57 of 2,464 ticks one sample early, so 'constant tempo is byte-identical' was false for the phrases golden (handoffs/evidence/o4-golden-floor.txt, from o4-baseline/golden_floor_flips.py). 96, 120 and 128 BPM: 0 ticks differ.
Found while checking a tempo claim, not by the reviewer: the tick is 192 per quarter in the code and 192 per whole note in the manual (D0, WENGE-0012).
No code was written or changed. cargo test was not needed for a documentation-only change; the pull request's CI is the check.
unresolved: D0 to D6 in section 0 of the plan need the owner's answer. D0 first: the tick length changes what every ms figure means. Owner: @beaudesign
D3 is a loosening of A4 and needs an ADR (reason, expiry). Owner: Conductor, on the owner's approval
The 'after' figures in the plan are a model (o4-model.txt), not the engine. The tests are the arbiter. Owner: Metronome
A loopback test in Live 12 is a release condition this session cannot meet. Owner: @beaudesign
next: Owner decision on the plan. If approved: step 1 of section 10 (guard tests and the null host, committed alone), then PR 4a, 4b, 4c. If changes are asked for: revise the plan only. No code until then.
